subject: general
question: The name of the state having highest rainfall in India is_______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya**__**.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **The highest rainfall in India is at Cherrapunji(Present name Sohra) in Mawsynram village of Meghalaya state.**
 
• **The Average rainfall of **Cherrapunji is 11,777 mm or 463.7 in.
